svg.title: Geometry-grounded perception
svg.desc: Human and robot observations enter a VLM. Shared hand geometry grounds a residual adapter, whose conditioning tokens inform an action expert. The frozen shared encoder supplies action latents, and noised actions are inputs to the expert.
svg.metadata: 500ms entry wait; six ordered stages425ms apart,375ms entrance; complete after3s, then remain visible. Original geometry and paint order retained.
